name: Aryan Mehta
quote: The UI/UX Design program at Academy of Design completely transformed my career. The mentors bring real industry experience, and the hands-on projects gave me a portfolio that landed me my role at Flipkart within 3 months of graduating.

name: Shreya Kapoor
quote: I had zero background in fashion when I joined. The structured curriculum and personal attention from every instructor helped me build both technical skills and a distinct design identity. Now I design collections for Myntra's in-house brand.

name: Vikram Nair
quote: The Interior Design program is far ahead of any traditional institute. Real-world project briefs, industry visits, and a faculty that actually practices what they teach — this is what sets Academy of Design apart from everyone else.

name: Meera Iyer
quote: What I love most is the emphasis on both aesthetics and function. You don't just learn to make things look beautiful — you learn why they should be designed a certain way. That mindset shift is what put me ahead in every interview I walked into.

name: Rahul Sharma
quote: The AEC program is comprehensive and rigorous. From parametric design to sustainable architecture, every module pushed me to think bigger. I was placed at Morphogenesis, one of India's leading architecture firms, straight out of the program.

name: Priya Verma
quote: I came from a management background wanting to transition into design. The mentorship here is unlike anything else — they didn't just teach me tools, they changed how I think about every problem. That shift opened doors I didn't even know existed.

name: Tanvi Desai
quote: The fashion curriculum here is deeply rooted in craft but always forward-looking. I discovered my niche in textile design because of the breadth of exploration the program encourages. I've since collaborated with NIFT on two exhibitions.

name: Karan Bhatia
quote: The research modules and user testing frameworks taught here are exactly what companies like Microsoft look for. I went in as a junior designer and came out with a senior-level skillset. Best investment I've made in my career by far.
